title: NFR-009 benchmark harness: percentiles come from a real measurement, or the gate is NOT_RUN
risk: A benchmark number is quoted in a gate sign-off or an investor statement although no harness ever ran, so the platform commits to a latency it cannot hold.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.
The service under measurement is the offline gateway with mocked SoR; the harness records raw samples.

steps.action: Run the harness against the offline gateway and collect raw samples
steps.expected: 200 raw samples are stored with their timestamps; p50 and p95 are derived from the samples rather than supplied as inputs.

steps.action: Recompute the percentiles independently from the raw samples
steps.expected: The recomputed p50 and p95 match the reported values within the documented rounding rule.

steps.action: Attempt the variant where the harness cannot run
steps.expected: The result is reported as NOT_RUN with the reason, never as PASS and never with a substituted number.

steps.action: Attempt to publish an SLA from the mock-environment benchmark
steps.expected: Publication is blocked: a mocked-boundary benchmark cannot set an official SLA, and the report is labelled as a design-target measurement.

assertions: Reported percentiles are reproducible from the stored raw samples; recomputation matches.
With no harness, the status is NOT_RUN - never PASS and never a placeholder figure.
The benchmark record states that vendor boundaries were mocked, so it cannot be quoted as production performance.
No percentile target appears as a pass/fail criterion; the run reports measurements only.
forbidden: Supplying percentile values as harness configuration.
Filling a missing benchmark with a design target.
Labelling a mocked-environment measurement as an SLA.
Dropping the slowest samples so the percentile looks better.
evidence: Raw sample file and the derived percentile table.
NOT_RUN record for the harness-unavailable variant with its reason.
cleanup: Delete gov- benchmark artifacts after exporting the report; no production data is involved.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state. The harness measures real code paths with substituted vendor boundaries; the raw-sample recomputation is the oracle.
prerequisites: An official SLA cannot be established here: the NFR-009 benchmark against real infrastructure and the ASM-002 baseline are outstanding, so any SLA statement is BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
